The six debugOptic force names are halo, sundogs, pillar, anticrep, paraselene and lunarhalo. simTime without timeScale freezes the clock-driven scene. Use the real-time recipe above for a 15–60 second motion check. Flag activation alone does not prove visible motion or correct optical pixels.

Lunar force checks require an eligible night Moon. Near-new, below-horizon, daylight and unavailable-surface cases cannot gain moonlight from a diagnostic flag. Retain the physical scene inputs and crops for optics, and the real 15–60 second watch/clip/delta for motion; never use `qaState().clouds.hash` as motion proof.

**Current lunar light permission:** The shared `nativeLunarPresentation` helper grants `moonLightEligible` only when its phase, lunar-altitude, solar-darkness and failed-surface checks permit it. When the helper reports `near-new`, `below-horizon`, `daylight` or `surface-unavailable`, it withdraws atmospheric moonlight; diagnostics do not override that permission. Calendar-body Earthshine and the stellar cutout are separate. This gate does not establish current V5 surface availability or native optical pixels.
